prompts.prompt:
Create a production-oriented animation sprite sheet for a 2D top-down pixel survival game. Use the supplied image only as character design reference. Extract ONLY the specified monster identity; do not include other monsters.
OUTPUT LAYOUT ABSOLUTELY REQUIRED: landscape 1536 by 1024 pixels, exact 6 columns by 4 rows, 24 equal square cells of 256 by 256 pixels, no gutters, no margins, no labels, no grid strokes. Every cell contains exactly one full-body pose of the same monster. All poses have consistent size, body proportions, colors, and equipment. Fixed camera, facing SOUTH toward bottom of screen with a slightly overhead Mini DAYZ-like camera, never turn around. Each figure centered at x=128 inside its own cell, ground anchor near y=224; generous transparent padding at every edge so no limb ever crosses into another cell. No floor, no ground shadow, no haze, no background texture; TRUE clean transparent RGBA background.
STYLE: crisp deliberately low-resolution pixel art, clearly visible square pixel clusters, hard edges, muted gray-green, olive, rust-orange fungal growths; no glossy rendering, no blur, no gradient background. Character design must stay the same between poses. Not a portrait or illustration: separate game animation frames.
READ LEFT TO RIGHT:
Row 1 IDLE six frames: neutral, slight inhale, deeper inhale with shoulder rise, exhale, slight head twitch, return to neutral. Small changes, feet anchored.
Row 2 WALK six-frame looping gait: left foot forward/right arm forward counter-swing appropriately, passing, right foot forward, opposite passing, returning stride, near start. Feet clearly alternate and body bobs gently. No position travel across cell.
Row 3 RUN six-frame looping gait: stronger forward lean, longer alternating steps, passing pose, opposite stride, brief airborne pose, return; visibly faster and more dynamic than walk. No translation across sheet.
Row 4 ATTACK six frames: ready, windup, maximum windup, strike/contact, follow-through, recovery. Distinct readable gesture and consistent anatomy, no added equipment, no victim, no gore.
The animation should show actual articulated limb movement, not just six identical poses shifted around. All 24 poses must be present, evenly spaced and isolated.
MONSTER SPECIFICATION: RUNNER, the slim humanoid in the reference upper-left, torn olive jacket, gray trousers, bald pale head with small rusty fungal patches, long thin arms. Human sized. Attack: right claw winds back then sweeps forward; recover. Run is fast and desperate.
